Version property returns None instead of expected string value

#### Description

When accessing the `version` property on core properties, it returns `None` instead of the expected version string value.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document

# Create or open a document with version property set
doc = Document()
core_props = doc.core_properties

# This should return the version string but returns None
version = core_props.version
print(f"Version: {version}")  # Expected: "1.2.88", Actual: None
```

The issue appears when trying to read version information from document core properties. The version property should return the string value but instead returns `None`.
</issue>
